shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '110,170p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
rg -n 'registry.acceptance|jest|test:' .github package.json src/orchestration/tools -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n 'validateInput|inputSchema|Invalid inputSchema|additionalProperties|tool result' src/orchestration/tools docs README.md .specify specs -g '*.ts' -g '*.md'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import Ajv from 'ajv'; const v=new Ajv({allErrors:true}).compile({type:'object',properties:{ssn:{type:'string'}},required:['ssn']}); v({ssn:123456789}); console.log(v.errors)\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import Ajv from 'ajv'; console.log(Ajv.version, (await import('ajv/package.json',{with:{type:'json'}})).default.version)\"; rg -n '\"ajv\"|node_modules/ajv' package-lock.json | head -20"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix tool input validation build failures" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
